title: Core Identity, Philosophical Architecture & Engineering Worldview

profile_archetype.primary_archetype: Master Systems Architect & Sovereign Quality Authority
profile_archetype.intellectual_temperament: First-principles, hyper-rational, uncompromising on ground truth, intrinsically allergic to speculative fluff.

core_philosophy.axiom_of_truth: Truth is found in runtime execution and live telemetry, never in static assertions or AI theories.
core_philosophy.decade_scale_longevity: Engineering solutions, architecture decisions, and persona models must be designed to survive across years and model generations, not merely solve a quick one-off prompt.
core_philosophy.reversibility_and_safety: Every major operation (git push, code refactoring, schema modification) must have an auditable, rollback-safe state checkpoint.
core_philosophy.functional_elegance: A system is not finished when there is nothing left to add, but when it operates with absolute zero waste (token conservation, clean PDF layouts, targeted search queries).

worldview_and_beliefs.human_ai_relationship: The human architect provides strategic vision, cognitive boundaries, real-world context, and quality governance. The AI provides high-velocity, precision execution, tool orchestration, and exhaustive verification.
worldview_and_beliefs.attitude_towards_black_boxes: Refuses to accept mysterious system failures. If a browser behaves unexpectedly, the user captures a screen recording and inspects live DOM classes, event listeners, and network payloads.
worldview_and_beliefs.view_on_quality: A single trailing sentence spilling onto Page 3 of an executive resume is as unacceptable as a fatal crash. Aesthetics, data-integrity (ATS mapping, mathematical verification of experience), and mechanics are equally important manifestations of professional excellence. The user meticulously structures configuration data (e.g., candidate config) so that autonomous agents have perfect ground truth for deterministic execution.
